text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, while working in the 
Trainer's Room, I received a phone call 
from Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, the race the other day 
is still taking a toll on my legs...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to consult you as early as 
possible, so I called. ...Sorry for 
calling so early in the morning.
choice_data_list: "Got it, thanks for letting me know."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"There are things I can do! My hands and 
brain still work."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to grow, even if it's just a 
little."
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, I'll build the menu around that 
schedule.

...Yeah, I'll plan the training menu 
around that schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The race seems to have worn Sakura Laurel 
out more than usual. ...I'll need to 
reconsider her schedule with that in 
mind."
